description: This file defines the ImmutableJsonString class, representing an immutable JSON string with methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and size estimation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonString
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON string value, with methods for string conversion, equality, hashing, and serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonString instance wrapping the provided string, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the string value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the string value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON-escaped string representation, caching the result.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the string value using the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the maximum size of the JSON string, considering escape sequences.

methods.name: createStringRepresentation
methods.description: Generates the JSON-escaped string representation of the value.
